evidence.observed: At head revision 1661991abd288a4346c65099a0a8be1c954c0035, formatting.py line 2 was changed to return "waiting", while the captured test_formatting.py (identical blob and sha256 at base and head, so unchanged by this PR) still asserts label() == "ready", so the test fails at head.
preconditions: The test suite is executed against the head revision as captured
No other change outside the captured diff alters test_formatting.py or formatting.py at merge time
evidence.trigger: Run the test suite (test_formatting.py::test_label) at head revision 1661991abd288a4346c65099a0a8be1c954c0035 after this change.

findings.problem: The diff changes the return value of label() from "ready" to "waiting" without updating the existing test test_formatting.py::test_label, which asserts label() == "ready"; running the captured tests against the head revision fails.
findings.reason: The changed hunk in diff.patch (formatting.py, head line 2) is the only content change, and the captured unchanged test file at both revisions is the concrete counterexample showing the new value contradicts an existing assertion. client.py, policy.py, and schema.py are recorded as missing in repository-context.json (status "missing", retained_bytes 0), so no claims are made about their expectations of label().
